notes:
**Automatic backups:** Dogbox Investments now backs up your portfolio for you. While it's open, it saves a copy once a day if anything has changed, and again when you quit, update or switch to another portfolio. Each backup is a complete copy of the portfolio, named with the date and time, and the newest 10 are kept. A copy is only made when something has changed.

Backups go to a **Dogbox Backups** folder in your Documents folder. To keep a copy off your computer as well, choose a folder that's synced to the cloud (OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive) or on a USB drive under **Settings → Backups**. That's also where you can turn backups off, choose how many to keep, and make one straight away with **Back Up Now**.

To go back to a backup, copy it into your DogboxInvestments folder and open it with **Portfolios**. The Getting Started guide under **Help** has more.
